required_reviewer_independence: The reviewer must not modify the reviewed commit or use author-supplied conclusions as evidence. Any defect keeps P0 blocked and returns remediation under a later commit.
required_checks: all reviewed artifacts are read from the exact target commit and match the frozen SHA-256 values
the design validator passes while execution_authorized and training_allowed remain false
source access refuses before an exact v12 CONSUMED marker and opaque in-process capability
the log root is a real non-symlink directory and all nested directory and log symlinks refuse
only portable ASCII relative log paths accepted by the frozen sha256sum line grammar are allowed
historical ordering requires exact GNU coreutils sort 8.22 with LANG en_US.UTF-8 and no LC_ALL or LC_COLLATE override
historical ordering output must be an exact permutation of the discovered relative paths
both ordered digests are computed from one file-hash snapshot and either single-lane mismatch refuses
the expected inventory schema is exact and cannot omit either ordering lane or the driver-log count
the public API exposes no injected orderer or bypass hook
no candidate join release publisher scheduler entrypoint held job registration or execution authority exists
direct module execution exits with code 2 before source access
focused negative tests cover guard refusal sort version permutation symlink path grammar and both single-lane mismatches
review performs no A B or BLIND source access and no real execution
